mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rate hike episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of labor market strengthening episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% triggers a risk-on equity reaction as investors anticipate continued job growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in low unemployment episodes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 106.1173 signals robust manufacturing momentum, which supports corporate earnings forecasts and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of high-INDPRO episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 791.0 units signals resilient consumer demand, which boosts earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high-HOUST episodes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 216.71 indicates a cooling price environment, which reduces growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in cooling inflation episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.1173 signals a softening supply side, which compresses earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in low-INDPRO episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.
